summary: Acast AB (publ) operates as a podcasting company in Europe, North America, and internationally. It provides podcast marketplace and building technology to connect podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. The company also operates a podcast platform to host and distribute their podcast. In addition, it offers podcast advertising services for promotion of the brand; and monetization opportunities for podcast creators and advertisers. Acast AB (publ) was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
